mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Unemployment rate remains above 8.0% for two consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based weakening in consumer demand that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate revenue.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the same month but S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) signals aggressive monetary tightening that suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average indicates expanding manufacturing output and corporate capacity utilization, supporting higher earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains above its 12-month moving average for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 650.0 (thousand units), it signals strong consumer confidence and housing market activity that boosts retail sales and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST exceeds 650.0 for two consecutive months but S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.5%), a rising labor force (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly) signals labor market recovery that increases consumer spending and corporate revenue, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 7.5%, PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% monthly but S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above its 3-month moving average indicates robust consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS remains above its 3-month moving average for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.
